name: Chasing Shadows
description: The person Diluc called in turned out to be Jean from the Knights of Favonius. After some discussions, it is discovered that it was the Fatui who stole the Holy Lyre der Himmel. You must retrieve it to rescue Dvalin.

steps.description: Player returned to the world. Tavern cleared.
Talk to the NPC in room 1
Negotiation with NPC fell apart - trigger before combat
Negotiation with NPC failed - combat loop
Talk to the NPC in room 2
Negotiation with NPC 2 fell apart - trigger before combat
Negotiation with NPC 2 failed - combat loop

Obtain the Holy Lyre der Himmel

dialogs.content: No, NO! Don't eat me! Ah? You're... You're human?
The entire floor's defenses... have been broken. I thought it was the Abyss Order attacking...
We have come for the Holy Lyre der Himmel.
H—How did you guys know the lyre's here?
The place it's being kept is locked up tight. If you're after the key, keep going further into the ruins, but d—don't come after me!
I don't know which one of the guards has it, but I'm sure you can find the guards and find out for yourselves.
This guy looks like he's about to wet himself...
Y—You just worry about yourselves!
One of the Harbingers is already in Mondstadt.
Signora. When she gets her hands on you she's going to string you up and torture you. When that time comes, don't you dare say a word about me.
We have come for your life.
Ahh, Ah, Ah!
No, don't! I have valuable information! I'll tell you!
We hid the Holy Lyre in the depths of these ruins.
Wh-Who are you? Wh-What are you doing here? Argh!
Give up. No one's coming to rescue you.
Did you already beat all the other guards?
Enough talk. Stick 'em up!
Ahh!? You're just going to attack me!?
Ah...
Fine. Not like I have a choice anyway.
Alright. You're free to go.
But I don't have the key unfortunately. You'll have to ask the next guard you come across.
Hehe...
I've had enough!
I am a proud citizen of Snezhnaya! I will not falter!
I am a proud citizen of Snezhnaya! I will not falter!
Fine. Not like I have a choice anyway.
Alright. You're free to go.
I have the <color=#00E1FFFF>key</color> here. You can head in from the hall outside, but don't tell anyone that it was me who gave you the key.
W-Who are you? How'd you get in here!?
We are goodwill ambassadors from the Snezhno-Mondstadtian Association.
Never heard of that association before...
What are you lot doing here?
We wish to borrow the Holy Lyre der Himmel.
That lie's way too obvious. You really haven't got anything better?
And just how do you plan to "borrow" it?
We are here to do goodwill... stuff.
Oh? Keep talking...
Hmm, you're here for the Lyre, aren't you?
We are investigating you for alleged corruption.
What? How did you little brats creep in here? You take me for a fool?
Hmm, you're here for the Lyre, aren't you?
There's nothing to discuss. Give up now.
Ha... Like hell!
Wow...
Okay...
Okay. Sounds like a plan.
Alright. You're free to go.
But I don't have the key unfortunately. You'll have to ask the next guard you come across.
Hehe...
Think you can look down your nose at me, huh?
The will of Snezhnaya is as solid as the permafrost! I will not yield!
The will of Snezhnaya is as solid as the permafrost! I will not yield!
Okay...
Okay. Sounds like a plan.
I have the key here. You can head in from the hall outside, but don't tell anyone that it was me who gave you the key.
Finally, the lyre is back in safe hands!
Where did that guy go, though? He was here a second ago...
Signora is going to end you. The songs bards sing of your demise will be so terrifying — the people of Mondstadt will never sleep again for the nightmares they give them.
Big talk for a guy who still ran off in the end... Chicken.
Scram! You already got what you wanted!
G—Go, quickly! Get out of here! Go find someone else!
Wh-Who are you? Wh-What are you doing here? Argh!
Hehe...
I've had enough!
I am a proud citizen of Snezhnaya! I will not falter!
I kicked their Snezhnayan butts.
What!? I—I'm not scared of you. An Agent will come to my aid!
No, but they got called back to Snezhnaya on urgent business.
What!? I—I'm not scared of you. An Agent will come to my aid!
Oh, I dealt with him already.
We both know you're making that up.
He's getting drunk at the Cat's Tail.
Wow...
Don't even try to say you don't owe me...
What're you still doing here? Don't get me into trouble.
W-Who are you? How'd you get in here!?
Hehe...
Think you can look down your nose at me, huh?
The will of Snezhnaya is as solid as the permafrost! I will not yield!
How does 500,000 Mora sound?
We'll recommend you to the Association.
Have an apple!
Wow...
